method_python: Scalar Python calls with Python floats on 930 operating points (Vgk -4..+1 V x 30, Vak 50-350 V x 31). Each timed block = 20 passes over the points, divided by the call count; 3 warm-up blocks per case, then 41 blocks per case interleaved across cases; median (and min) block reported. time.perf_counter_ns, single thread. call_overhead = the same loop calling an empty function; *_net ratios subtract it.
method_c: dk/bench_triode.c: the same 930 points in C arrays, each form a noinline function writing (Ig, Ia, J); 3 warm-up blocks, then 41 blocks of 2000 passes per form interleaved; median (and min) block, CLOCK_MONOTONIC. max_rel_diff = largest |after - before| / |before| over the outputs.

libm_calls_per_call.currents_before: 4 exp + 2 log1p + 4 pow = 10 (issue's count: 2 softplus + 2 sigmoid + 4 pow = 8)
libm_calls_per_call.currents_after: 2 exp + 2 log1p + 2 pow = 6 (issue's count: 2 softplus/sigmoid pairs + 2 pow = 4)
